title: Additional index declared over cleartext
description: requirements.txt declares a requirements file that adds a cleartext extra index. An artifact fetched over plain HTTP can be replaced in transit, so the bytes that install are not bound to what the author published. This rule reads a requirements file that adds a cleartext extra index.
remediation: Use the HTTPS endpoint the registry publishes and keep the hostname in the configuration reviewable. Specifically: fix a requirements file that adds a cleartext extra index.
limitation: It matches a requirements file that adds a cleartext extra index in the parsed requirements.txt; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
